name: doctor-reacts
label: Clinician reacts to a viral claim
description: Recreated claim card or in-app stitch, freeze-frame verdict, diagram explanation, what's actually true, takeaway.

sync.broll: claim clip/card ~40%; anatomy/study graphics on 'here's what actually happens'
sync.fillers: freeze-frame + pause SFX on the claim, punch-in for the verdict, MYTH/FACT cards every 10-20 s
sync.music: upbeat intro → silence on the freeze/verdict → low bed under explanation → back at the outro
sync.transitions: freeze-frame as act break, whoosh into graphics

evidence: est. from public sources; calibrate with measured references
compliance_lock: general education only, no individual advice
react to the claim, not the person; no likeness of real people without rights (commentary-controversy.md)
